notes.title: Notice of Price Revision
notes.content:
Starting December 21, 2024, the price of the Steam version of "Strania - The Stella Machina -" will be revised as follows:

- USD
	Before: $14.99
	After: $11.99

- EUR
	Before: €14.79
	After: €11.79

- Other Regions
Prices will be adjusted based on the current USD/EUR exchange rates as of December 2024.

Thank you for your understanding and continued support.

notes.title: Strania - The Stella Machina - Ver 1.03 Release / Ver.1.03 リリース
notes.content:
[h1]Ver.1.03 Patch details[/h1]

[list]
[*]Fixed bug that would display mistake of the leader board.
[*]Fixed bug that would don't work with some digital devices.
[/list]

[h1]Ver.1.03 アップデート内容[/h1]

[list]
[*]リーダーボードに登録されている名前が崩れて表示されている不具合を修正
[*]一部デジタルデバイスで動作しない不具合を修正
[/list]
